# Micah 6 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Listen to what the LORD is saying: "Stand up and state your case against Me. Let the mountains and hills be the witnesses."

**2** "And now, O mountains, listen to the LORD's complaint! He has a case against His people. He will bring charges against Israel.

**3** "O My people, what have I done to you? What have I done to make you tired of Me? Answer Me!

**4** I brought you out of Egypt. I redeemed you from slavery. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to lead you.

**5** My people, remember the story of King Balak of Moab and what Balaam son of Beor said to him. Remember your journey from Acacia Grove to Gilgal. Remember — so you can understand how faithful I have been to you."

**6** "What can I bring to the LORD? Should I bow before God Most High with burnt offerings, with year-old calves?

**7** Would the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams? With ten thousand rivers of olive oil? Should I sacrifice my oldest child for my rebellion? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?"

**8** No, the LORD has told you what is good, and this is what He requires of you: to do what is right, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God.

**9** The LORD calls out to Jerusalem! Listen, you who fear His name! "Pay attention to the rod of punishment, and to the One who is wielding it.

**10** Are there still treasures gotten by wickedness in the house of the wicked? And that detestable short measure?

**11** How can I tolerate your dishonest merchants with their weighted scales and bags of rigged weights?

**12** The rich among you have become wealthy through violence. The people are so used to lying that their tongues can no longer tell the truth.

**13** "Therefore, I have already begun to destroy you because of all your sins.

**14** You will eat but never have enough. Your hunger will gnaw away inside you. You will try to save money, but it will come to nothing, and what you do save I'll hand over to invaders.

**15** You will plant but not harvest. You will press your olives but not use the oil. You will crush grapes but never drink the wine.

**16** You have followed the wicked examples of Kings Omri and Ahab. You have continued their evil practices. So I will make an example out of you, bringing you to complete ruin. You will be mocked by people everywhere."

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **6:3**: God asks His people, 'What did I do wrong? How did I wear you out?' The vulnerability in that question is staggering — the Creator of the universe asking, 'Where did I fail you?'

- **6:8**: This is it. If you had to reduce the entire Old Testament to one verse, this might be it: do justice, love mercy, walk humbly. Everything else flows from these three things.

- **6:6-7**: The escalation is the point: would God want calves? Rams? Rivers of oil? My own child? Each offer gets more extreme, exposing how badly we misunderstand what God actually wants. He doesn't want MORE — He wants DIFFERENT.

— PNEUMA
